reasoning: This checkout implements the llm-d Inference Payload Processor, a deployable Go application that runs as a standalone data-plane service. The README and architecture documentation describe a service invoked by an inference gateway over Envoy external processing; cmd/main.go starts the runner, and the code contains request/response handlers, processing and data-layer runtime components. The Helm chart is an application chart that creates a Deployment and ClusterIP Service. Although the project uses Kubernetes APIs and defines a Kubernetes-shaped configuration type, it does not primarily implement an operator or reconciliation controller. It is not a library because it has an executable and deployment manifests, and it is not merely configuration.
